detail.longDescription: Fake Brand Sites in AI Answers AI answer engines can cite look-alike domains as if they were your official site, and most governance programs cannot see it. This article gives CAIOs and GRC leads a working control set: prompt audits, ownership classification, certificate and registration monitoring, a takedown ladder, KPIs and a worked example with arithmetic shown, mapped to NIST, ISO, ICANN, WIPO and IETF instruments. https:// hernanhuwyler.wordpress.com/20 26/11/17/fake-brand-sites-in-ai-answers/
